uart.signal: a raw-register firmware (examples/nucleo-l432kc/firmware/main.c) enables RCC AHB2ENR/APB1ENR1, puts PA2 on AF7 and writes USART2 TDR; the sim captures the banner and a uart_contains oracle matches it. A negative control that moves the USART2 clock gate to the wrong APB1ENR1 bit captures zero bytes. Stock stm32duino NUCLEO_L432KC also prints LW_L0_OK on USART2 in the Arduino matrix
uart.lane: core-ci board lane (configs/ci/boards.yml nucleo-l432kc, gate: true) + core-arduino-matrix-smoke (nightly 02:20 UTC + push to main)

spi.signal: stock stm32duino SPI = SPI1 (PB3/PB4/PB5) clocks the MAX31855 device model and accepts ONLY the exact default kit frame 0x01901600; any other word prints LW_L4_FAIL frame=0x...; the verdict returns on USART2
spi.lane: core-arduino-matrix-smoke / arduino-matrix-gate (nightly 02:20 UTC + push to main)
spi.note: needs ststm32@19.7.1 (the CI pin): 20.0.0 makes SPI.begin() a no-op. Evidence examples/nucleo-l432kc/evidence/arduino-matrix/L4_spi_sensor, 2026-11-15

i2c.signal: stock stm32duino Wire = I2C1 (PB6/PB7) reads the INA219 model's config register 0x399F and bus-voltage register 0x19CA; LW_L3_OK prints only on that exact pair (the L4 takes the exact tier, not the ACK-only one)
